newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt vows to insure finance, bank deposits.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt vows to insure finance, bank deposits.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya and central bank governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi on Wednesday pledged unconditional government insurance of deposits at non-suspended finance companies and commercial banks.

"We, as government, would provide unconditional guarantees of all deposits, and creditors (of financial institutions), when they mature, in all cases. The public should not panic or confused (by rumours)," Thanong said.
The officials gave the assurance after meeting with representatives of 15 commercial banks and 33 unsuspended finance firms at the Bank of Thailand.

The minister said the healthy Thai banks and finance firms did not face any public run on their deposits but the market was hit by rumours of instability of financial institutions on Wednesday morning.

The assurance came one day after the government announced the suspension of 42 cash-strapped finance firms for at least three months while they worked on revival plans. This is in addition to 16 firms suspended in late June.
